provenance.error: RuntimeError: layer-stream staging for layer(s) 0 is still on loan: get() handed it out and release() was never called, and now layer 64 has been requested. With PINNED staging the host-to-device copy is still draining when load_async returns, so recycling that buffer puts another layer's weights on the device with no error at all — measured 6 of 8 layers at the default depth. Call release(idx, event) once the copy is enqueued; layer_stream_runtime._release_source is what the buffer pools use. (Pageable staging permits the implicit release, because its copy is host-synchronous.)
